passing: Retain contextual references without manufacturing source positions.
brief: Retain the spoken view and its immediate qualifiers without inventing details.
substantive: Preserve conclusion, mechanism, meaningful conditions, limitations and source confidence.
deep: Preserve the full reasoning chain, positive and negative paths, relevant comparisons, context, disagreements and uncertainty.
structural: Preserve the broader game or weekly strategy independently of any one player; link affected subjects and conditions.

title: Weekly Fantasy / Start-Sit
description: Week-specific fantasy recommendations, rankings, streams, alternatives, role expectations and conditional start/sit calls with source attribution.
principles: A weekly recommendation expires with its NFL week and must not overwrite enduring Dynasty evaluations.
Start/sit, FLEX, sleeper, streamer and avoid labels must reflect spoken source recommendations, not inferred sentiment.
Keep conditions tied to opponent, teammate injuries, lineup needs, league format and alternative starters when stated.
Preserve exact weekly ranks or tiers only if source-stated, and always preserve explicit player comparisons.
Maintain host attribution, conviction, uncertainty and timing. Later game results must not rewrite original calls.
Source takes are never automatic Mighty Giants lineup decisions; final start/sit belongs to the weekly decision process.

review_questions: Does every weekly call identify its season and week?
Are start/sit strength, alternative players and reasons preserved accurately?
Are injury contingencies, game script and scoring-format limitations attached to the original claim?
Are individual host recommendations distinguished where necessary?
Can weekly player takes be linked to a game-wide forecast when both exist?
Are longer-term evaluations kept separate from this week's start/sit call?
forbidden_distortions: Never infer start/sit from generic praise or a favorable matchup alone.
Never change a conditional FLEX suggestion into a mandatory start.
Never invent exact rank, fantasy points, confidence or injury status.
Never use Mighty Giants roster context as though the podcast made a specific call.
Never alter the original take using information that emerged after the episode.
extension_signals: Multi-game waiver and streaming articles require additional source-scoped context.
A recurring weekly value type cannot be represented by the existing take types.
Weekly profiles repeatedly need additional explicit horizon/format dimensions.
